messages:
deploy-bot: Gradual rollout started for service="infer-svc" version="v2.14.0" regions=[eu-west] target=10->50% (step=10%) — kicked off at 15:42 UTC. Watchers: @maria @sre-jen @jon
maria: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs right after step 1 :eyes: can someone confirm scope?
jon: checking edge logs now
sre-jen: correlating — evictions on kv-cache shards a/b spiked at the exact minute of the step, memory thrash looks likely :warning:
patrick: if kv-cache is thrashing we should hold. recommend freeze at 10% and surface a rollback plan.
maria: hold requested. pls pause further steps and do not advance to 20% until we confirm.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rollout paused at 10%. No further steps will run.
lina: quick check — tokenizer errors? I've got a small sample with tokenization warnings but it's 0.03% noise. logs: ```WARN tokenize: dropped token at pos 127 file: s3://logs/abc```
sre-jen: tokenizer noise is separate. kvcache evictions are high (see tail): ```evict shard=a count=432 evict_ms=12.3 mem_free=120MB``` looks reproducible on two hosts.
ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-054 (severity=2) — assigned to @sre-jen and @maria.
patrick: agree we freeze. options: 1) fix kvcache config and recommit, 2) pin region to previous stable (v2.13.9) while we triage. Recommend option 2 for fastest recovery.
maria: I volunteer to trigger pin/rollback if we get +1 from oncall.
jon: +1 for rollback to v2.13.9 in eu-west. :thumbsup:
sre-jen: +1. I'll continue investigating post-rollback.
deploy-bot: Rollback command for eu-west: `deployctl rollback --service infer-svc --region eu-west --to-version v2.13.9 --no-warmup`
maria: executing rollback now. will announce progress.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback to v2.13.9 in eu-west — 0/4 hosts completed.
deploy-bot: progress: 2/4 hosts replaced, draining old pods, migrating traffic.
deploy-bot: rollback complete — all hosts on v2.13.9, traffic at 100% in eu-west.
maria: traffic looks stable, 5xxs back to baseline. thanks all.
patrick: leaving a note: we'll cherry-pick kvcache fix into the next canary build and run a micro-bake in staging before reattempting rollout.
sre-jen: I'll attach heap profiles and eviction traces to the incident.
ops-bot: Updated incident INC-2026-054 with rollback actions and next steps.
maria: I'll update the release notes to mark v2.14.0 as reverted for eu-west and schedule a follow-up postmortem early tomorrow. link to notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/infra/2026-03-23
jon: thanks. re-open the channel if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
